.github/workflows/example.yml:6:1  note  suppress-wildcard
  jobsworth-ignore * hides every rule on this line, including future ones

context:
  directive      jobsworth-ignore *   at :6   applies to line 6

suppress:
  add on line 6:    # jobsworth-ignore suppress-wildcard
  or in .jobsworth.yml:   rules: { suppress-wildcard: off }
